operations.description: Close this connection's actual native menu, including mod windows Mineflayer cannot represent. Requires observed window/state and server epoch. Cursor cleanup follows the normal native close behavior. Reconcile unknown results by requestId; never replay automatically.
Read the capabilities actually installed on this connection. Local adapter names alone are not capabilities.

One authoritative sample of this body's position, vitals, equipment, original inventory items and current menu. Absolute block coordinates; health/hunger in Minecraft points; capturedAt is the sample time. Unavailable mod mana is null.

Inspect an original item by canonical player-menu slot 0..45, independently of a mod menu. Includes real registry ID, translated Component, components SNBT and completeness. Slot 0 is a crafting preview, not owned inventory.

Read loaded server recipes, sorted by recipeId. At most 12 per page and 16 KiB per recipe response; partial pages retain nextOffset. Alternatives are choices, not simultaneous ingredients. Definition visibility does not prove a machine action was executed.
Read the actual open menu, slot ownership, progress values and cursor, with full item components when available. Window 0 is the player menu. No guessed chest or machine layout.

One native PICKUP click on this connection's already open menu. Requires fresh window/state, complete native item and cursor preconditions. Slot or permission denial is a business result. Unknown outcomes must be queried by the same requestId and never replayed automatically.
Reconcile this player's original requestId without executing it. Missing/expired receipts and a different server epoch mean unknown, never success or permission to replay.
